What we do

House painters Woollahra homeowners and strata managers rely on

Sydney Paintmasters paints homes, apartments and commercial spaces across the Woollahra area. Interior repaints, full exterior jobs, heritage terraces, unit blocks, shopfronts and roofs. We cover the lot. Our team works in-house, so the painter who quotes your job is the same crew that finishes it.

This part of the eastern suburbs is not a one-size-fits-all market. A Federation home in Woollahra needs careful timber and render prep. A waterfront place in Vaucluse cops salt air and hard sun. A strata block in Edgecliff needs a plan that keeps residents happy while the work runs. We price each of those honestly and stick to it.

Twenty years in, we have learned the shortcut is usually the expensive one. So we prep properly, use quality coatings, and leave your place clean. Simple as that. For work outside this area, see our main Sydney painting page.

Local painters across every Woollahra suburb

Nine suburbs, one local team. Here is how we approach each, and what makes the paintwork different street to street.

Double Bay painters2028

Commercial centre

Double Bay mixes prestige homes with one of Sydney’s tightest retail strips along Bay, Knox and Cross Streets. We paint boutique shopfronts, cafe fitouts and heritage-listed facades, plus the apartments and terraces behind them. Trading-hours access and clean, low-disruption work matter here, so we plan around them.

Vaucluse painters2030

Heritage harbourside

Vaucluse is large heritage homes and established estates, near landmarks like Vaucluse House. That means conservation-minded prep, careful treatment of period render and timber, and colours that respect the street. Exteriors here also face salt air and strong sun, so we spec coatings built to hold their finish.

Rose Bay painters2029

Waterfront and retail

Rose Bay runs from waterfront homes to the New South Head Road shops. Salt-laden air off the harbour is tough on exteriors, so surface prep and UV-resistant systems do the heavy lifting. We handle houses, unit blocks and retail frontages across the suburb.

Bellevue Hill painters2023

Hilltop family homes

Bellevue Hill is the biggest Woollahra suburb by population, full of large family homes on steep hillside blocks. Tall exteriors and multi-level facades need safe access and steady hands. We repaint interiors and exteriors here with finishes chosen to last on exposed, sun-facing walls.

Get a Bellevue Hill quote →

Darling Point painters2027

Apartments and mansions

Darling Point pairs grand harbourside homes with a lot of apartment living. We paint unit interiors, common areas and the exteriors of heritage residences. Body corporate work is scheduled to suit residents, and single-apartment repaints get the same care as the big jobs.

Get a Darling Point quote →

Edgecliff painters2027

Transport and mixed use

Edgecliff is a busy mixed-use pocket around the interchange, heavy on apartments and offices. We do unit repaints, strata common areas and commercial spaces here, working around foot traffic and building access. Quick turnarounds without cutting corners on prep.

Get an Edgecliff quote →

Point Piper painters2027

Waterfront estates

Point Piper is a small, exclusive peninsula of high-end waterfront estates, many in Federation and Arts and Crafts styles. Detail matters. We give period timber, render and decorative features the slow, careful prep they need, and use premium coatings that stand up to the harbour edge.

Coastal village

Watsons Bay sits right at the harbour mouth, so homes here take the full force of salt, wind and sun. Its historic village character calls for finishes that protect without looking out of place. We prep hard, seal well, and pick systems made for coastal exposure.

props.label: Quotes, booking and insurance
props.html:
Booking and quotes

Quotes, booking and insurance

The questions we get asked most before a job starts.

How do I get a painting quote in Woollahra?
Call 0423 019 087 or fill in the quote form on this page. We arrange a time, come and look at the job, and send you a fixed written price. There is no call-out fee and no obligation to go ahead.
How much does painting cost in Woollahra?
It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces, and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior repaint of a heritage home. We do not quote blind. After we see the property, you get a fixed price in writing, so the number you agree to is the number you pay.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry insurance. Ask us for our current certificate of currency when we quote and we will send it through.
Is there a call-out fee to get a quote?
No. Quotes are free and there is no call-out fee. We would rather see the job in person and price it accurately than guess over the phone.
How do I book Sydney Paintmasters?
Once you are happy with the quote, we lock in a start date that suits you. Call 0423 019 087 or use the form and we will confirm the schedule.
Do you give fixed-price quotes?
We do. The price is fixed once we have inspected the property and agreed the scope. It only changes if you ask us to add work, and we confirm that with you first.
What are your hours and when can you start?
We work 6AM to 6PM, Monday to Saturday, and we are closed Sunday. Start dates depend on the size of the job and current bookings, but we handle the quote quickly so you are not left waiting.

On prestige homes the finish is the whole point. We take extra care with trim work, refined colour schemes and smooth, even coats, and we protect established architectural features and joinery while we work.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Local questions

Painting in the Woollahra area, answered

Heritage, coastal exposure, strata and coverage. The local detail that matters here.

Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Woollahra?
Yes, it is one of our specialities. Woollahra and Paddington have a lot of Victorian terraces and Federation homes with decorative timber and period render. We prep these carefully and use finishes that protect the detail rather than swamp it.
Can you work with heritage colours and conservation area rules?
We paint plenty of homes in and around heritage conservation areas and work within approved colour schemes. Where council approval or a heritage colour palette applies to your property, we can paint to it. Check specific approval requirements with Woollahra Council, and we will match the work to what is approved.
Do you paint harbourside homes exposed to salt air?
Yes. Homes in Rose Bay, Vaucluse, Watsons Bay, Double Bay and Point Piper face salt, wind and strong sun. We prep hard and use coatings built for adhesion and UV resistance, which helps guard against peeling, fading, mould and salt-related damage.
Do you do strata painting in the eastern suburbs?
We do. Strata work covers common areas, facades and unit blocks for owners corporations. We stage the job, schedule around residents, and keep everyone informed while the work runs. Call 0423 019 087 to discuss a building.
Which suburbs around Woollahra do you cover?
All nine Woollahra suburbs: Woollahra, Bellevue Hill, Darling Point, Double Bay, Edgecliff, Point Piper, Rose Bay, Vaucluse and Watsons Bay. If you are just outside this list, ask us and we will let you know.
Do you paint apartments and unit blocks?
Yes. Areas like Edgecliff and Darling Point have a lot of apartment living. We paint single units, whole floors and common areas, and we keep the work tidy and low-disruption for other residents.
Do you handle exterior and roof painting too?
We handle both. Exterior repaints cover render, weatherboard, brick and timber, and roof painting covers tile and metal with cleaning, priming and protective coatings. Both are quoted with the same fixed price up front.
